business_model.narrative_summary: Neuland Laboratories is positioned in the Expansion Stage of its life cycle, transitioning from a generic API manufacturer to a high-margin Custom Manufacturing Solutions (CMS) provider.

capital_allocation_philosophy.narrative: Neuland is fully capitalized with strong internal cash generation supporting expansion plans.

execution_track_record.narrative: Management has successfully pivoted the company towards high-margin custom synthesis.

forward_guidance.narrative: Management claims FY26 would be a year of strong growth.

governance_and_board.narrative: The company is highly professionally run with top-tier institutional governance.
